mainEntity.name: Can I get a construction loan for a shell-only metal home build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Conventional residential mortgages and construction loans typically require a turnkey contract with a licensed general contractor before issuing approval. Lenders require a certified Certificate of Occupancy upon completion to protect their investment, which an unfinished shell cannot satisfy. If you want to finance a shell build, you usually need a specialized land or personal loan, or substantial private cash reserves to fund the interior work until the dwelling qualifies for a permanent mortgage.
